questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The history of every British king and queen
How to organise a street party in your town
Why the Royal Family is popular abroad
The Queen's jubilee and a pudding contest
questions.why: Neil says they look at the Platinum Jubilee by hearing about a competition to make the official jubilee pudding.

questions.q: What does the Platinum Jubilee celebrate?
options: The Queen's seventieth birthday
70 years since she became Queen
25 years since her coronation
The opening of Buckingham Palace
questions.why: Sam says it commemorates 70 years since she became Queen in 1952.

questions.q: What makes this jubilee so special, according to Neil?
options: No British monarch has ruled for 70 years before
It is the first jubilee with a four-day holiday
It is the first jubilee celebrated outside the UK
It is the first time the Queen has had a parade
questions.why: Neil says she is the first British monarch ever to spend 70 years on the throne.

questions.q: Which of these is part of the Platinum Pageant?
options: A football match in front of the palace
A cake-making show on television
Puppets of the Queen's corgi dogs
A speech by the Queen at St Paul's
questions.why: Neil says the pageant features music, dancing, puppets of the Queen's corgi dogs and Ed Sheeran.

options: Eating a Victoria sponge at every royal wedding
Holding a cake competition every year in London
Serving coronation chicken at street parties
Inventing a new dish to celebrate a jubilee
questions.why: Sam says there's a tradition of inventing a new food dish to commemorate jubilees.

questions.q: What is the winning Platinum Pudding?
options: A trifle with lemon Swiss roll and amaretti
A chicken dish with a curry cream sauce
A new version of the Victoria sponge cake
A chocolate cake with cream and mandarins
questions.why: Daniella Relph says the winner is a lemon Swiss roll and amaretti trifle, a twist on a traditional trifle.

questions.q: How did Jemma Melvin feel when her trifle won?
options: Calm, because she expected to win
Disappointed with how it looked
Amazed, as the others were lovely
Worried that people wouldn't like it
questions.why: She says 'I cannot believe it!' – the other desserts were beautiful, so her win feels 'a bit surreal'.

questions.q: Why did Jemma base her pudding on a simple trifle?
options: Because the Queen doesn't like fancy desserts
So that everyone in the country can make it
Because it was the cheapest recipe in the competition
Because the rules said it had to be a trifle
questions.why: Sam says she wanted a humble trifle, something everyone around the country can make – 'the people's pudding'.
